segments: Linh scrolled through job listings in her cozy apartment. Suddenly, a posting from 'Global Connect' caught her eye. It was her dream international company! Because of this, Linh opened her laptop to start writing her English CV and the application email for Global Connect. This was harder than she expected.

Because of this, Linh knew she needed help with her English writing. Then, she remembered her phone and quickly searched for 'online English writing courses'. Later, at a cozy cafe, she found a good course. She paid for it using a QR code on her phone, feeling a little hopeful.
